_comment: Baseline for bench/plsql-parse/measure.mjs --check. fingerprint = order-independent sha256 over extractPlSqlFacts output for every lang-resolution/plsql-* fixture file plus a 20-subprogram synthetic package body (correctness gate; re-baseline intentionally on a legitimate facts change). scaling_budget = max allowed (t_large/t_small)/(lines ratio) for 60 vs 240 synthetic subprograms after a DFA warm-up; ~1.0 is linear (0.95 measured), ~4.0 quadratic.
